metadata.title: Storage Core Security Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the foundational security guarantees enforced directly by storage platforms, providing data-centric confidentiality and protection independent of applications, compute, orchestration, or automation context.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for managing the secure storage, protection, and stewardship of research datasets throughout their lifecycle.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for the secure and compliant storage of institutional records and governed information assets.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Persistent storage technologies, including block, file, object, and virtualized storage platforms providing data durability and access.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes baseline trust assumptions for platform-level storage services that persist and protect data independently of consuming applications or compute environments.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Research datasets requiring durable confidentiality and protection across platforms and time.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Institutional records subject to legal, regulatory, and policy obligations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines data-centric security architecture principles requiring confidentiality and cryptographic protection to bind directly to data regardless of platform, workload, or application context.

components.title: Encryption at Rest Enforcement
components.description: Enforces cryptographic protection of stored data regardless of workload, application, or access method.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Adversaries seek plaintext data via credential abuse or destructive impact on unprotected storage.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Credential dumping and data destruction target unencrypted data at rest.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Renders exposed or stolen storage content unreadable through encryption.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic key establishment and management are enforced.
Storage encryption keys are centrally managed.

components.title: Encryption in Transit Enforcement
components.description: Ensures all access paths to storage services are cryptographically protected against interception or manipulation.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Network discovery and command-and-control activity exploit cleartext storage access.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Protocol abuse targets unencrypted storage traffic.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Protects storage access via encrypted transport.

components.title: Data-to-Key Binding
components.description: Binds stored data to cryptographic keys that remain valid across workload and lifecycle changes.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Key compromise enables offline data decryption.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Secret and key material harvesting enables unauthorized data access.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Separates key access from data access to reduce blast radius.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Keys are managed independently of workloads.
Key usage is bound to authorized storage contexts.

components.title: Enforcement Independence from Compute
components.description: Ensures storage security remains effective even if compute or orchestration layers are compromised.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Persistence mechanisms abuse compromised execution environments.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Autostart persistence maintains durable access paths.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Isolates storage enforcement from compute compromise.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Storage controls are isolated from application components.
Dependency and supply chain risk to data protection is reduced.
Only essential storage functionality is enabled.
